Package com.hkust.marketplace.data

Class EncryptedJsonStorage

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.data.EncryptedJsonStorage
All Implemented Interfaces:
Storage
public class EncryptedJsonStorage extends Object implements Storage
Saves the data as JSON, encrypted with DataCipher, in one file; deleted-account snapshots and listing photos go to encrypted files of their own, in folders next to it: 
 marketplace-data/
   marketplace.dat            all data (encrypted JSON)
   marketplace-audit/G12.txt  data snapshot of audit log entry G12 (encrypted)
   marketplace-photos/I31.img listing photo I31 (encrypted, so it cannot be opened as a picture)
Each save writes a temporary file first and then replaces the old file, so a crash while saving cannot leave a half-written file. A save is skipped when nothing has changed.
